sources.text: Latest Articles: New Immunotherapy Markers in Pancreatic Cancer & Clinical Trials The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center A translational oncology & regenerative medicine laboratory dedicated to research on pancreatic cancer lead by Gregory Botta, Contact Us Medical Oncology | UCSD Pancreatic Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center A translational oncology & regenerative medicine laboratory dedicated to research on pancreatic cancer lead by Gregory Botta, Contact Us Medical Oncology | UCSD Pancreatic Cancer Center About Us Our Lab Dr. Botta's laboratory is broadly dedicated to understanding the mechanisms of gastrointestinal & pancreatic cancer growth and metastasis. Using pancreatic cancer as a model, we develop small proteins (peptides) to hijack tumor immune and metabolic processes for drug development, novel combinations and drug repurposing to reduce toxicity. Our Core Projects Our current cancer-drug development programs at the Botta Lab focus on: (1) hijacking nutrient pathways for pancreatic cancer drugs, (2) developing peptides that reverse pancreatic cancer immune suppression, and (3) applying circulating tumor DNA technology to unlock cancer growth programs with vaccines and CAR-T. Advanced Genomic Techniques At the Botta Lab, we implement the newest genetic techniques to map the metabolism of pancreatic cancer and the regulatory pathways of immune cells. Our single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics protocols are designed to characterize individual cells from patient tumor samples. Contact For any questions or collaborations regarding Dr. Botta and the Botta Lab, please feel free to reach out. Email Address Botta Lab Core Projects: Hijacking Nutrient Metabolism with Peptides Single Cell RNA Sequencing & Spatial Transcriptomics Reversing Cancer Immunosuppression via Peptides We utilize 3D in vitro and in vivo genetically engineered mouse models to effectively target cancer through peptide delivery of therapeutics. Reversing Cancer Immunosuppression via Peptides Single Cell RNA Sequencing & Spatial Transcriptomics Reversing Cancer Immunosuppression via Peptides In the Botta Lab we have unlocked novel peptides capable of destroying suppressive cells and thereby activating anti-tumor responses. Single Cell RNA Sequencing & Spatial Transcriptomics Single Cell RNA Sequencing & Spatial Transcriptomics Single Cell RNA Sequencing & Spatial Transcriptomics We utilize sophisticated single cell sequencing techniques to deconstruct patients' tumors, cell by cell, in order to uncover weaknesses to exploit. Contact Us For any scientific questions or collaborations, please reach out to the Botta Lab.
